title: refactor(plugin-designer): the dashboard designer picks with the shared Select (objectui#11865)
body:
Part of #11865
Clause-②: no

This is slice i of claim `6069665700` on objectui#11865: the dashboard designer. `DashboardEditor`'s widget property panel picks a widget's Type and Color Variant, and `PropertyEditor` draws a `select` field, with the shared `Select` (`packages/components/src/ui/select`) instead of a browser-native select element. The card stays open for the other native selects; slices h and j of the same claim are separate PRs.

## What changed

- `packages/plugin-designer/src/DashboardEditor.tsx`: the Type and Color Variant pickers go through one module-private `WidgetPropPicker`, modelled on the earlier slices' pickers (objectui#11976 `RulePicker`, #12005 `CreatePicker`).
  - Items carry their option's index, not its value, so the picked option is resolved against the list that rendered the items.
  - An option may be disabled, as a native option element was: the Type picker still disables the types the widget door refuses the widget's measures under (objectui#8894), and the write guard beside it is kept.
  - A stored value no option carries gets an item of its own, labelled with the value.
  - `id` lands on the trigger, so each label `htmlFor` still names its control.
  - The colour options are a typed list (`COLOR_VARIANTS`), so a pick reaches `onChange` as the widget's own `colorVariant` type, with no cast of a DOM string. The value written is the same string.
- `packages/plugin-designer/src/components/PropertyEditor.tsx`: a `select` field goes through one module-private `PropertySelect`, the same index-token pattern, so an option whose value is empty needs no empty `SelectItem`. The value is matched as the native control matched it: the field's value as a string, empty when it has none.
- New pins: `DashboardEditor.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx` (31 tests) and `PropertyEditor.sharedSelect-11865.test.tsx` (13 tests).
- Three existing suites drove the native controls and now pick through the trigger, with their assertions unchanged in meaning:
  - `DashboardEditor.measureDoor-8894`: it reads the options off the opened list (each item carries its type as `data-option-value`, a disabled one says so with `aria-disabled`), and a pick of a refused type still writes nothing;
  - `DashboardEditor.i18nTitle` and `DashboardEditor.slotComponentArm-11598`: one colour pick each.
- `.changeset/11865-i-dashboard-editor-shared-select.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-designer: patch`.

No export, prop or i18n key moves: `DashboardEditorProps`, `PropertyEditorProps` and `PropertyField` are unchanged, and `packages/components/src/ui/**` is not edited.

## The dispatch's hypotheses, measured

- **H1, value parity: holds.** A scratch probe (uncommitted, deleted before the first commit) fired a change event on every native option on base `902fbe190` and read what `onChange` received. The new pins compare each row as JSON text against those literals:
  - Type: 5 options on a one-measure widget, 5 on a two-measure widget. On the two-measure widget KPI Metric and Pie Chart are disabled and write nothing, on base as now.
  - Color Variant: 8 options on a widget with none set, 3 on a `teal` widget. Default writes `colorVariant: "default"`, as before.
  - `PropertyEditor`: 6 rows, the empty-value option included (it writes `onChange("kind", "")`).
  - Caveat: the probe's change event fired for the current option too, which a browser's native select does not do, so the re-pick rows ("writes nothing") pin the primitive.
- **H2, names, keyboard and read-only.**
  - Names: Type and Color Variant are found by `getByRole('combobox', { name })`, read on base the same way. `PropertyEditor`'s field had no accessible name on base (its caption is a sibling label that names no control), and it keeps none, as the dispatch asks.
  - Keyboard: Enter opens a picker and Enter on an option selects it, pinned on both surfaces.
  - Read-only: `DashboardEditor`'s `readOnly` disables both triggers. They wear the primitive's own `disabled:` classes and do not open, with a writable CONTROL. `PropertyEditor` has no read-only state (its props and fields declare none).
- **H3, a stored value outside the options: holds.** A stored `area` type shows `area`, where base showed "KPI Metric". A `metric-card` entry shows `metric-card` (base: "KPI Metric"). A stored colour outside the list is shown (base: "Default"). A `PropertyEditor` value outside its options is shown (base: the first option), and a field with no value and no empty option shows nothing (base: the first option). Re-picking the outside item writes nothing.
- **H4, first-load bytes: byte-neutral.** It was measured before the first edit: base `902fbe190`, `apps/console` `CI=true vite build` under the lock, then `dist/eager-closure.json`.
  - Both files ship in the lazy chunk `src-Bg0yZV49.js`, which the entry chunk reaches only through `lazy(() => import(...))`. It is not among the 336 eager members.
  - Base reads eagerGzipBytes 3391326, eagerRawBytes 11496190.
  - Head `56dea3f5e` reads 3391325 and 11496190, with the same 336 eager chunks: 0 raw bytes and −1 gzip byte. The one eager chunk that moves is the entry chunk: identical raw bytes, with the lazy designer chunk's hashed name inside it changed. The designer code ships in the lazy chunk `src-kZPNwCPn.js` on head.
  - `pnpm check:eager-closure` on head: "Console eager closure is 3311.8 KB gzipped across 336 of 2458 chunks (budget: 3312.0 KB, headroom: 0.2 KB)."
  - The budget bot's reading on this PR is for the seat to quote after CI.

## Evidence on `56dea3f5e`

- Repo-root `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-designer/ packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/column-identity.ratchet.test.ts scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`: "Test Files 47 passed (47)", "Tests 369 passed (369)". That is every plugin-designer suite (45 files: everything that mounts `DashboardEditor`, `DashboardDesignPage` or `PropertyEditor`) plus the two repo-wide pins. Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-designer type-check` (echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), after the `@object-ui/plugin-designer^...` build (Scope: 17 of 47): VERDICT command-exit 0. By `--listFilesOnly`, both sources are in the main program and all five touched suites are in the test program.
- `pnpm exec eslint --format json` on the 7 touched files: 0 errors, 4 warnings. All 4 are `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` in `DashboardEditor`'s untouched main component, and the base blob gives the same 4 via `--stdin`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: "7 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)". `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: "0 new citation(s)". `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK.
- Derived by hand from objectui's `package.json` and workflows, all exit 0:
  - `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-claims`, `check-lint-coverage`, `check-type-check-coverage`;
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:self-import`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:i18n-keys`;
  - `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only).
- Not measured locally: `check:readme-exports` needs every package's dist and stopped on that prerequisite. This diff touches no README and no export. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full test farm are CI's.

**Reverse leg.** The implementation was committed first (`6a01f72f3`). Both source files were then written from their base blobs: `08bce46f` and `776f26e8`, landing proven by hash, with 2 and 1 native selects and 0 pickers. The new pins and the three converted suites read "Tests 48 failed | 12 passed (60)", VITEST-EXIT 1.
- The green 12: both name pins, the writable CONTROL, and the nine untouched cases of the converted suites. That is the predicted direction.
- `56dea3f5e` corrected the `DashboardEditor` pin's header, which had named the name pin alone.
- The trap restored with `git checkout HEAD --` on absolute paths. Hashes `99f0f1a3` and `24606bf0` equal the HEAD blobs; `git diff HEAD` was 0 bytes and the status had 0 entries.

**ProcessDesigner markup.** `ProcessDesigner.readers-11434` compares drawn markup with React ids normalised, and its property panel now draws a Radix trigger. A scratch probe (deleted) rendered one document twice with the panel open: raw markup equal, no generated id in it. That suite needs no change, and it passes in the run above.

## Acceptance notes

- `carrier: none`: `PropertyEditor`'s field caption is a label beside the control that names no control, so a `select` field's trigger has no accessible name, on base as now. Measured with testing-library's name computation. This is a11y polish with no public door measured.
- `carrier: none`, read-only inference: the Type picker is offered on a `metric-card` entry too, and a pick writes `type` onto that entry. Whether the resulting entry is refused at publish was not measured. This PR leaves that write path as it was.
- Browser: NOT MEASURED in this slice. Keyboard and read-only are pinned in the test DOM only.

Commits carry objectui `AGENTS.md`'s model-free trailer pair. Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01MgfduSkFrfM3eorB3UGfAU`.
